name: Kroc Row
instructions: Take a very heavy dumbbell and a staggered stance, one hand braced on a bench.
Row the dumbbell hard to your hip with an aggressive, powerful pull.
Allow some body English — this is a high-rep strength builder. Aim for 20+ reps per arm.
Rest, then match the reps on the other side.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: Kroc Row is an advanced pulling exercise for the lats, performed with dumbbells. Pulling balances all the pressing we do in life and keeps the upper back and posture strong.
